domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 频率域中以位移响应与作用力之间关系表征的动力柔度。
usage_overview: 用于从频域考察结构受力后的位移响应，识别共振特征，并比较不同支承形式及结构模型的动力差异。在车辆—轨道及土体模型分析中，也用于比较结构随频率变化的抗变形能力。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

complete_examples.text: The track receptance is normally obtained considering one wheel-rail contact point except [11] in which the cross point receptances, namely the responses of the rail under different wheelsets excited by a harmonic point load under a specific wheelset were analysed.

In railway engineering, receptance (displacement frequency response function) or mobility (velocity frequency response function) of railway tracks have been studied both theoretically and experimentally in a detailed manner for different track systems, e.g. conventional ballasted tracks [4–6] and slab tracks [7–10] without considering the vehicle effects.
